```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load required packages
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(openxlsx)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(enrichR)
library(here)

library(enrichR)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define input and output paths
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEAT_SIGNATURE_CSV <- here("output/3.heat_signature/data/heat_signature.csv")

OUTPUT_DIR <- here("output/3.heat_signature/1.signature_generation/")

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = F, recursive = T)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check required inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
required_inputs <- c(
  HEAT_SIGNATURE_CSV
)

missing_inputs <- required_inputs[!file.exists(required_inputs)]

if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing input file(s):\n",
    paste(missing_inputs, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

```

# Introduction

This notebook performs enrichment analysis fo the HEAT signature using EnrichR.

# --- Enrichr HEAT signature analysis ---
```{r}
## -----------------------------
## Load HEAT signature genes
## -----------------------------

heat_genes_tbl <- read_csv(HEAT_SIGNATURE_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

## Adjust this column name if needed
heat_genes <- heat_genes_tbl %>%
  pull(1) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

## -----------------------------
## Enrichr setup
## -----------------------------

websiteLive <- getOption("enrichR.live")

if (websiteLive) {
  listEnrichrSites()
  setEnrichrSite("Enrichr")
}

if (websiteLive) {
  enrichr_dbs_available <- listEnrichrDbs()
}

dbs <- c(
  "ChEA_2022",
  "ENCODE_TF_ChIP-seq_2015",
  "ENCODE_and_ChEA_Consensus_TFs_from_ChIP-X",
  "GO_Biological_Process_2025",
  "GO_Cellular_Component_2025",
  "GO_Molecular_Function_2025",
  "KEGG_2021_Human",
  "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020",
  "Reactome_Pathways_2024",
  "WikiPathways_2024_Human"
)

## -----------------------------
## Run Enrichr
## -----------------------------

if (websiteLive) {
  
  access_time <- Sys.time()
  
  enriched <- enrichr(
    genes = heat_genes,
    databases = dbs,
    background = background
  )
  
  enriched <- lapply(names(enriched), function(db_name) {
    
    enriched[[db_name]] %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(
        database = db_name,
        enrichr_accessed_at = access_time,
        input_gene_set = "HEAT_signature",
        n_input_genes = length(heat_genes),
        .before = 1
      )
  }) %>%
    setNames(names(enriched))
}

## -----------------------------
## Clean worksheet names
## Excel allows max 31 characters
## -----------------------------

make_sheet_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("[\\[\\]\\*\\?/\\\\:]", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("GO_Biological_Process_2025", "GO_BP_2025") %>%
    str_replace_all("GO_Cellular_Component_2025", "GO_CC_2025") %>%
    str_replace_all("GO_Molecular_Function_2025", "GO_MF_2025") %>%
    str_replace_all("ENCODE_TF_ChIP-seq_2015", "ENCODE_TF_2015") %>%
    str_replace_all("ENCODE_and_ChEA_Consensus_TFs_from_ChIP-X", "ENCODE_ChEA_TF") %>%
    str_replace_all("Reactome_Pathways_2024", "Reactome_2024") %>%
    str_replace_all("WikiPathways_2024_Human", "Wiki_2024") %>%
    str_sub(1, 31)
}

sheet_names <- make_sheet_name(names(enriched))

## -----------------------------
## Create summary table
## -----------------------------

enrichr_summary <- bind_rows(enriched) %>%
  group_by(database) %>%
  summarise(
    n_terms_total = n(),
    n_terms_adj_p_lt_0_05 = sum(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_term = Term[which.min(Adjusted.P.value)],
    top_adjusted_p_value = min(Adjusted.P.value, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_combined_score = Combined.Score[which.max(Combined.Score)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(top_adjusted_p_value)

## -----------------------------
## Optional combined significant table
## -----------------------------

enrichr_significant <- bind_rows(enriched) %>%
  filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(database, Adjusted.P.value)

## -----------------------------
## Metadata table
## -----------------------------

enrichr_metadata <- tibble(
  field = c(
    "analysis",
    "input_gene_set",
    "n_input_genes",
    "background_used",
    "enrichr_accessed_at",
    "databases_queried"
  ),
  value = c(
    "Enrichr enrichment analysis of HEAT signature genes",
    "HEAT_signature",
    as.character(length(heat_genes)),
    ifelse(exists("background"), "Custom background supplied", "No custom background supplied"),
    as.character(access_time),
    paste(dbs, collapse = "; ")
  )
)

readme_tbl <- tibble(
  sheet = c(
    "README",
    "Enrichr_summary",
    "Significant_terms",
    "HEAT_genes",
    "Enrichr_metadata",
    "Database specific sheets"
  ),
  description = c(
    "Description of workbook contents.",
    "Summary of enrichment results by database.",
    "All terms with adjusted P value < 0.05 across all queried databases.",
    "Input HEAT signature genes used for enrichment.",
    "Metadata documenting Enrichr access time, input gene set, and queried databases.",
    "Full Enrichr result table for each individual database."
  )
)

## -----------------------------
## Save workbook
## -----------------------------

dir.create(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "enrichr_results"),
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

supp_xlsx <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "enrichr_results",
  "HEAT_signature_Enrichr.xlsx"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  border = "Bottom"
)

## Helper function
add_clean_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, data)
  addStyle(
    wb,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    style = header_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = seq_len(ncol(data)),
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  freezePane(wb, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  addFilter(wb, sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)))
  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

add_clean_sheet(wb, "README", readme_tbl)
add_clean_sheet(wb, "Enrichr_summary", enrichr_summary)
add_clean_sheet(wb, "Significant_terms", enrichr_significant)
add_clean_sheet(wb, "HEAT_genes", tibble(gene = heat_genes))
add_clean_sheet(wb, "Enrichr_metadata", enrichr_metadata)

for (i in seq_along(enriched)) {
  add_clean_sheet(
    wb = wb,
    sheet_name = sheet_names[i],
    data = enriched[[i]]
  )
}

saveWorkbook(wb, supp_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

## -----------------------------
## Save R object for reproducibility
## -----------------------------

write_rds(
  x = enriched,
  file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "enrichr_results", "enriched_heat.rds")
)
```
